purpose: Choose an evidence-backed LoopX resource level on a local desktop without discarding higher-cost capabilities.

speed_quality_contract.principle: Optimize speed only by selecting among function-preserving execution versions; never trade away required capability, safety, evidence, rollback, or authority.

customer_visible_outcome.rule: Minimize the Codex client task wall clock when client turn metadata is available; use independent monotonic timing and lifecycle wall clock only as cross-checks or explicit fallbacks.

execution_efficiency.rule: Use internal timing to explain and reduce customer-visible delay, not as a replacement objective.

quality_and_safety.rule: Hard floor: quality, privacy, rollback, authority, and validation gates cannot be traded for speed.

measurement_contract.clock: Codex client turn metadata when available; monotonic Stopwatch and UTC wall clock as cross-checks
measurement_contract.start_event: Codex client turn startedAt for customer timing; caller task anchor only as lifecycle fallback
measurement_contract.end_event: Codex client turn completedAt for customer timing; accepted-save-point-or-final-verified-result for lifecycle timing
measurement_contract.comparison_rule: Compare only equivalent function and acceptance envelopes; keep step and end-to-end metrics together.

speed_quality_contract.selection_rule: Choose the fastest version that can still satisfy the current goal, evidence gap, quality floor, and stop condition.
speed_quality_contract.escalation_rule: Switch upward only when the current version cannot answer the next decision or close the evidence gap without losing the quality floor.
speed_quality_contract.deescalation_rule: Switch downward after evidence becomes decisive or the frontier is unchanged; do not reduce required validation or safety checks.
speed_quality_contract.comparison_rule: Compare speed signals only between runs with equivalent required capability and acceptance criteria; a faster but incomplete run is not an improvement.

preliminary_routing.bounded_local_change: Auto with explicit ChangedPaths; retain Fast when no high-risk path is in scope
preliminary_routing.cross_owner_or_architecture_change: Balanced or Full according to evidence gap; keep owner and rollback gates
preliminary_routing.global_iteration_closeout: Full; do not replace the final repository and global-interface validation
preliminary_routing.repeated_same_evidence: reuse only when source revision, policy, authority, acceptance envelope, and validation profile match

timing_optimization_contract.candidate_rule: A timing improvement is retained only when at least two equivalent observations improve a declared layer without degrading another required layer; one observation remains a candidate.

economy.default_when: small bounded task or evidence is already decisive

balanced.default_when: the goal spans turns but does not yet justify continuous or visible coordination

full.default_when: additional lanes, visible handoffs, or repeated rounds are necessary to close a material evidence gap

economy.quality_role: complete required function set with compact context and one bounded lane
economy.switch_up_when: the next decision needs additional evidence, roles, or repeated rounds

balanced.quality_role: complete required function set with resumable multi-turn evidence accumulation
balanced.switch_up_when: a material evidence gap remains after bounded turns

full.quality_role: complete required function set with additional lanes, visible handoffs, and repeated evidence rounds
full.switch_down_when: the evidence frontier is unchanged, the goal is decidable, or additional lanes no longer improve evidence

selection_contract.escalation_rule: increase one level only when the current level cannot answer the next decision with acceptable evidence
selection_contract.deescalation_rule: return to a lower level after evidence becomes decisive or the frontier is unchanged

balanced.purpose: preliminary evidence for bounded work; not a global closeout substitute
balanced.completion_boundary: Full required for global iteration, publication, release, or final architecture closeout
